name: artifact
description: A Maven artifact that none of the analyzed repositories builds, such as a third-party library. Its key is groupId:artifactId.

name: BUILD_DEPENDS_ON
description: The subject module declares a Maven dependency on the object module or artifact.

scope.description: The Maven scope, such as compile, runtime or test.

version.description: The version the build asks for, if known.

optional.description: Present and true for an optional dependency.

artifactType.description: The artifact type if not jar, such as test-jar or pom.

coordinates.description: The groupId:artifactId the POM declares, when it differs from the object module's own: JitPack coordinates naming an analyzed repository.

name: PACKAGES
description: The subject service packages the object library as its main code, so the two form one deployable (a thin service repository and its .lib artifact).

name: version
description: The version the subject's build declares.

name: packaging
description: The Maven packaging of the subject module, such as jar, war or pom.

name: java-release
description: The major Java release the subject module compiles for, such as 21, from maven.compiler.release, the compiler plugin's release or source, maven.compiler.source or java.version, in that order.

name: parent
description: The coordinates of the subject module's parent POM, groupId:artifactId:version, as its POM writes them.

name: coverage-tool
description: A coverage tool the subject module's build runs, by its Maven plugin's groupId:artifactId, such as org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin.

goals.description: The goals the plugin's executions bind, sorted. Absent when none is bound in the POM read.

limits.description: For JaCoCo, the limits of the rules its check goal enforces, each with element, counter, value and minimum or maximum as strings, JaCoCo's defaults filled in. Absent when there are none.
